integrity_statement: A self-contained exact sign-table proof and reproducible exact-arithmetic checker are included. Self-review is not independent validation; unindexed broader coverage remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted, binary two-tier Ferrers interaction graphs with at least three row-guild species and resolution parameter one are treated.
Neighborhood inclusion is the sense of nestedness; tie-sensitive NODF maximality is not asserted.
No bound for all Ferrers graphs, statistical significance, demographic stability, or empirical prediction is asserted.
title: Sharp Barber modularity in two-tier perfectly nested ecological networks
